title: Methane Hydrates - Extended Interview Extracts With Natalia Shakhova
summary: Excerpts from Nick Breeze's 2012 interview with researcher Natalia Shakhova about methane release from the East Siberian Arctic Shelf. She discusses the risk of abrupt methane emissions.
why: HN cites it in methane and permafrost threads as an early warning that still looks relevant.

quote.text: This is from 8 years ago but it is very relevant today
